item.tib: gsang sngags kun gyi sngon 'gro ye shes lha dang srung ma'i gzhi thog rgyang 'bod
item.coloph: ye shes lha dang srung ma'i spyan drangs gzhi thog rgyang 'bod 'di ni/ rgyal sras ye shes blo gros kyis/ gnam mtsho'i do ring nas/ sgya lus 'byung bzhis 'jigs la thug dus su/ bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro bon skyongs bstan srung la bskang mdos phul skabs mdzad pa'o/ dge ba'i bstan dang 'gro la phan thog nas/ bkra shis zhal dro byin rlabs che bar shog/
